scope: Mapped independent fixtures for every registered everyday algorithm, emphasizing new extra modes. Uses current snapshot mode IDs/keys/metric labels. No checkout edits.
independence: Expected values come from exact arithmetic, independent Python standard library calculations, stated model equations, or pre-existing independent research. Actual engine results are stored only in a separate run report.
comparison: Numeric acceptance: abs(actual-expected)<=max(absoluteTolerance,relativeTolerance*abs(expected)); string equality exact. Random/amusement algorithms use contract properties.
